license.project_code_evidence: README.md at the pinned commit: '代码和文档：MIT'
third_party: real-instrument samples (CC0 / CC-BY, downloaded on demand by `om samples build`, not redistributed)
license.third_party_evidence: README.md acknowledgements and licence section at the pinned commit; see THIRD_PARTY.md upstream
excluded_without_separate_permission: the '豆子花叔' character artwork in runtime/clip/lib/toon.js and its likeness in the storytime template and the showcase film — the author's cartoon likeness, demo-only, not covered by MIT for other uses

runtime_requirements.browser: Chrome, Chromium, or Edge (the local browser drives render, still and check)
runtime_requirements.windows_status: UPSTREAM_NOT_VERIFIED; README states '目前只在macOS上实测过' (tested on macOS only)
runtime_requirements.doctor: `om doctor` reports Node, FFmpeg + ffprobe + encoders (libx264, prores_ks, libvpx-vp9, libopus) and Chrome

operation_contracts.check: om check [dir] [--samples n] [--source] [--json] — structure, scripts, files, motion rules, then sampled frames; exit code 1 when any finding is error-level
operation_contracts.still: om still <page.html|dir> [--at 0,2.5] [--out file] — a PNG of any page at the given times
operation_contracts.render: om render [dir] [--format mp4|mov|webm|gif] [--fps 30] [--out file] [--workers n] [--video extract|seek] [--frames jpg|png] [--blur n] [--silent] [--transparent] — exports into <dir>/out/
operation_contracts.qa: om qa [dir|video] [--loop] — single-frame pops, dead time, hard cuts, motion curve, loop seam over the newest render or a given video

project_shape.film: one index.html; every frame is produced by code and time (GSAP, Canvas, Three.js, SVG); no video-generation model is called
project_shape.runtime_helper: vendor/om.js (OM.clock / OM.region / OM.cue) is copied by `om new`
project_shape.scaffold: `om new <dir> [--template t]` copies templates/<t>; `om fork <dir> <newdir> --size 1080x1920` re-lays a project out for portrait
project_shape.variables: `om scan` returns variables, objects and scenes; `om set key=value` rewrites variable defaults inside index.html

output_notes: a render of 4 s or longer carries an upstream 'Made with huashu-motion' credit line in the last 1.2 s unless the film opts out
`om render` warns about a missing soundtrack unless `om sound` was run or `--silent` was passed; a silent clip is what the ContentOps motion gate requires
narration via `om voice` uses macOS system voices; on Windows a narration track must be supplied with `--audio <file>`
notes: Pin verified from the official v0.3.1 release and tag; the CLI contract above was read from cli/om.js and README.md at that commit. This record does not authorize installation, execution, source-media rights, publication, or final composition.
